text: RULING: JPM. JPM has a modest chance of beating the S&P 500 through 2026-12-31 because financial shares are gaining while technology shares weaken. Assume a US zero-commission account: the supplied schedule rounds charges to $0.00 on $100, but spreads and small sale fees still reduce returns; Indian broker, depository, securities transaction tax, stamp duty and GST charges do not apply to this assumed account. Gains over this holding period generally face ordinary-income taxation for US tax residents, but your residency is unknown, so an exact after-tax return or advantage cannot be established. I accept the pick with restrained confidence because sector leadership supports relative performance, while the brief does not establish that the whole market must fall.
